## Key configuration

name: floating-agent-daemon
requires-python: >=3.14
version: 0.1.0

## Modules

.claude/ape/ape_hook.py
floating_agent/__init__.py — floating_agent package.
floating_agent/__main__.py — `python -m floating_agent` → launch the native overlay.
floating_agent/agent/__init__.py — Agent core — the brain: a tool-calling loop over a pluggable LLM client.
floating_agent/agent/client.py — LLM client abstraction for the agent loop.
floating_agent/agent/loop.py — The tool-calling loop: prompt -> (tool calls -> results)* -> final answer.
floating_agent/agent/tools.py — Tool abstraction + registry exposed to the agent.
floating_agent/api/__init__.py — floating_agent.api package.
floating_agent/api/routers/__init__.py — floating_agent.api.routers package.
floating_agent/api/routers/health.py — Health check router.
floating_agent/api/routers/system.py — System monitoring router — CPU, RAM, disk.
floating_agent/main.py — Floating Agent — optional FastAPI HTTP layer (enabled via `--serve`).
floating_agent/models.py — Pydantic schemas for the daemon API.
floating_agent/overlay/__init__.py — Native PySide6 overlay — the surface of the floating agent.
floating_agent/overlay/app.py — Overlay application entry point.
floating_agent/overlay/tray.py — System tray icon with show/hide + quit, so the overlay is never lost.
floating_agent/overlay/widgets/__init__.py — Overlay widgets.
floating_agent/overlay/widgets/async_responder.py — Run a blocking responder off the Qt UI thread and deliver the result via signals.
floating_agent/overlay/widgets/chat_widget.py — Chat widget — sends user input to the agent and shows the conversation.
floating_agent/overlay/widgets/system_widget.py — System monitoring widget — polls the SystemPlugin and renders CPU/RAM/disk.
floating_agent/overlay/window.py — Frameless, always-on-top, translucent overlay window with drag-to-move.
floating_agent/plugins/__init__.py — floating_agent.plugins package.
floating_agent/plugins/calendar.py — Google Calendar client (read).
floating_agent/plugins/messaging.py — Gmail summary client (read).
floating_agent/plugins/notion.py — Notion REST API client (read/write).
floating_agent/plugins/system.py — System monitoring plugin using psutil.
floating_agent/proactive/__init__.py — Proactive engine — the differentiator: scheduled reminders that interrupt you.
floating_agent/proactive/notifier.py — Notification sinks for proactive events.
floating_agent/proactive/pulse.py — Phase 2 proactivity: the agent decides *when* to interrupt you.
floating_agent/proactive/reminders.py — Reminder model + in-memory store (Phase 1: explicit reminders).
floating_agent/proactive/scheduler.py — Cron-like in-process scheduler: fires due reminders through a notifier.
floating_agent/secret_store.py — Secret resolution — OS keychain first, environment variable as a fallback.
scripts/quality_gate.py
tests/__init__.py — Tests package.
tests/test_agent.py — Tests for the agent core: registry, tools, and the tool-calling loop.
tests/test_calendar_messaging.py — Tests for calendar + messaging tools and parsing (no live Google APIs).
tests/test_chat_widget.py — Tests for the overlay ChatWidget (responder runs on a Qt worker thread).
tests/test_health.py — Tests for health endpoint.
tests/test_notion.py — Tests for the Notion tools + page parsing (no live Notion).
tests/test_overlay.py — Tests for the PySide6 overlay (run headless via QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen).
